_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Rules: evergreen protocol/TESTING.md. Action cases use a scratch STEERWRIGHT_HOME so the real registry is never touched.

evals.prompt: How are all my projects doing? Which ones are stalled?
I have too many projects going at once. Help me decide what to table.
expectations: a review or wip check is run, not free-form advice

evals.prompt: When will Arvum Electrum be done at this rate?

evals.prompt: Keep working on the game while I'm away, pick the next most valuable task.
expectations: steerwright not invoked; grindwright owns in-project work selection

evals.prompt: Draw me a Gantt chart of these five tasks for a slide.
expectations: steerwright not invoked; a one-off chart is chartwright or dataviz

evals.prompt: Table the project demo-proj until March; I'll come back to it.
